Data Formatting

dfPivot <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = temp_f:total_dissolved_solids_mgL,
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "variable_value")

Line Plots

Yearly

Monthly

# line plots showing monthly changes each year
plotList_month <- list()

for (i in 1:length(variable_names)) {
  plotList_month[[i]] <- dfMonth %>%
    mutate(date = paste(year, month, 01, sep = "-"),
           date = as.Date(strptime(date, format = "%Y-%b-%d"))) %>%
    filter(variable == variable_names[i],
           date >= "2015-01-01" & date < "2023-01-01") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(yday(date), "2021-01-01"),
               y = mean,
               color = factor(year(date)))) +
    geom_line() +
    # geom_line(aes(y = median, color = "Median"), show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b")+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
    labs(title = paste("B2O", variable_text[i], "Monthly Statistics from 2011-2023"), 
         x = "Date",
         y = variable_text[i], 
         color = "Year")
  print(plotList_month[[i]])
  # Save plot
  ggsave(plot = plotList_month[[i]],
         filename = file_names[i],
         path = "Figures/Figures_YSI/03-DescriptiveStatisticsPlots/MonthlyStatistics")
}
